<cite ref="Tamid 32a:55-59">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>כל … בחד פְּתַרְנָא לך</he> whatever you asked of us, we all explained in the same way.

<cite ref="Ketubot 107b:10">Keth. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>פַּתְרִיתוּ בה כילי האי</he> have you gone so far in your interpretation? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:9:4">Y. Ber. Shek., p. 10ᵇ <he>ורבנן פַּתְרִין קרא בדואג וכ׳</he> and the Rabbis explain this verse (<cite ref="Psalms 3:3">Ps. III, 3</cite>) as a reference to Doeg &c.; a. fr.
